name: The Orchard Luxury Accommodation
address: 45 Thomas Road, Red Hill South VIC 3937
signature: Three rammed-earth apartments on ten acres in Red Hill South, each with a spa bath and a private deck overlooking the lake and valley.
editorNote:
The Orchard has three apartments, Apple, Cherry and Olive, on a ten-acre Red Hill South property. Each has a separate entrance, rammed-earth walls, a spa bath and a private deck overlooking the lake and valley. Choose the apartment layout that suits your stay rather than assuming every extra is the same.

The operator site invites guests to contact Frank directly and asks visitors to enquire before bringing a dog. Confirm current availability, dog terms and any extras with the host before booking.
whyWeGo: A rammed-earth apartment with a private deck and spa bath, looking across a quiet ten-acre property.
ifOnlyOneThing: Choose Apple, Cherry or Olive, then confirm current dog terms and stay inclusions with Frank before booking.
dogFriendlyNotes: Ask the host about bringing a dog and any conditions before booking.
